brief: Apply normalized camera selection or a mode-table camera transition.
decl: void record_selection_apply(RecordMachine &machine, std::span<const std::byte> pairs, std::span<const std::byte, 36> modes, std::span<const std::byte, 12> context, std::uint32_t mode, std::uint32_t &counter0, std::uint32_t &counter1);

bookkeeping.scope: Complete controller body and actual context predicate; callback handlers use declared observation/mutation substitutions.
bookkeeping.supported_domain: All signed preset inputs; low byte of mode selects direct versus table path. Valid current record, disjoint terminated pair table, mode table and context, distinct external counters. Signed nonnegative table index (>=9 is an early return). Caller-owned stable images and returning callback bridges.
bookkeeping.acceptance: Met: 1583 complete-body cases and twelve separate connected traces exact on MSVC and Zig/Clang with declared callback substitutions. Native suites 141/143 pass. See docs/recovery/camera-selection.md.
unresolved: Actual callback bodies and wider effects; integrated camera handler updates; negative mode-table indexes and original pointer faults.
